crossRefs.note: God said to him, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations will be from you, and…
All the souls who came out of Jacob’s body were seventy souls, and Joseph was in Egypt already.
Gideon had seventy sons conceived from his body, for he had many wives.

parallels.note: All the souls who came out of Jacob’s body were seventy souls, and Joseph was in Egypt already.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: All the souls who came with Jacob into Egypt, who were his direct offspring, in addition to Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were sixty-six.
translations.bsb: All those belonging to Jacob who came to Egypt—his direct descendants, besides the wives of Jacob’s sons—numbered sixty-six persons.
translations.kjv: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, which came out of his loins, besides Jacob's sons' wives, all the souls were threescore and six;
translations.asv: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, that came out of his loins, besides Jacob's sons' wives, all the souls were threescore and six;
